title: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
abstract: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. We present EgoGeneralist, which adapts pretrained video generators to unify action-conditioned egocentric video generation, pose estimation, and joint action-video generation. Our role-adaptive action renderer provides video-native representations for multidirectional action-video learning, making metric motion usable as both a spatial control signal and a recoverable generation target. Cross-stream action-video coupling establishes close correspondence between metric motion and visual dynamics through lightweight adaptation while preserving the pretrained visual prior. Together, these designs establish a generalist framework spanning five action-video tasks. Despite adaptation only on controlled laboratory recordings, EgoGeneralist generalizes to diverse unseen scenes and interactions with effective action control and visual quality, bridging pretrained visual knowledge and metric 3D human motion.
tldr: EgoGeneralist将预训练视频生成器统一用于自我中心动作视频生成、姿态估计与联合生成。
motivation: 现有视频模型具有强视觉先验，但无法以视频原生方式在度量3D空间中表示人类动作。作者希望统一动作条件自我中心视频生成、姿态估计与联合动作-视频生成。
method: 提出角色自适应动作渲染器，为多向动作-视频学习提供视频原生表示，使度量运动既可作为空间控制信号，又可作为可恢复的生成目标。通过轻量适配的跨流动作-视频耦合，在保留预训练视觉先验的同时建立度量运动与视觉动态的紧密对应。
result: 该框架覆盖五类动作-视频任务；在仅用受控实验室录像适配的情况下，模型可泛化到多样未见场景与交互，并保持有效的动作控制与视觉质量。摘要未提供定量指标。
conclusion: 该工作构建了覆盖五类动作-视频任务的通用框架，连接预训练视觉知识与度量3D人体运动，为统一自我中心动作理解与生成提供了新路径。

title: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
abstract: Visuomotor policies trained through imitation learning are highly sensitive to changes in camera viewpoint. This is particularly problematic for mobile manipulation (MoMa), where robots rarely execute manipulation from the exact same base pose used during demonstration collection due to navigation uncertainty, localization drift, and environmental constraints. Recent approaches use novel-view synthesis (NVS) to augment demonstrations with unseen viewpoints, but they assume static scenes and therefore fail to re-render the manipulated object during the post-contact interaction phase, leaving the most critical parts of the demonstration unaugmented. We present MOMASPLAT, a novel-view demonstration augmentation framework for mobile manipulation that synthesizes full manipulation trajectories from unseen robot base poses, including dynamic object interactions. Our key insight is that standard MoMa data collection naturally provides the multiview observations needed to reconstruct both the static scene and the manipulated object in 3D. MOMASPLAT combines 3D Gaussian Splatting, feed-forward 3D foundation models, and kinematics-based action retargeting to separately reconstruct the scene and manipulated object, render them from novel viewpoints, and generate geometrically consistent synthetic demonstrations paired with transformed actions. We evaluate MOMASPLAT on five real-world mobile manipulation tasks involving both rigid and articulated objects across three scenes, and validate the fidelity of its synthesized demonstrations against ground truth in simulation. MOMASPLAT substantially improves robustness to unseen base poses, more than doubling the average success rate of the strongest baseline and maintaining non-trivial success at large base displacements where all baselines fail, while reducing the need for largescale real-world data collection.
tldr: MOMASPLAT通过动态新视角合成增强移动操作示范，显著提升未见基座位姿下的策略鲁棒性。
motivation: 视觉运动策略对相机视角变化高度敏感，而移动操作中导航不确定、定位漂移和环境约束使机器人难以在与示范采集完全相同的基座位姿下执行操作。现有基于新视角合成的示范增强方法假设场景静态，无法在接触后交互阶段重渲染被操作物体，导致最关键部分的示范未被增强。
method: MOMASPLAT利用移动操作数据采集天然提供的多视角观测，分别重建静态场景与被操作物体，并从新基座位姿合成包含动态物体交互的完整操作轨迹。方法结合3D Gaussian Splatting、前馈3D基础模型和基于运动学的动作重定向，从新视角渲染场景与物体，并生成几何一致的合成示范及其变换后的动作。
result: 在三个场景的五项真实移动操作任务（含刚体和铰接物体）上评估，并在仿真中验证合成示范相对真值的保真度。MOMASPLAT将最强基线的平均成功率提高一倍以上，在较大基座位移下仍保持可观成功率，而所有基线均失败。
conclusion: 结果表明，动态新视角示范增强能有效提升移动操作策略对未见基座位姿的鲁棒性，并减少大规模真实数据采集需求。其贡献在于将动态物体重建与动作重定向结合到示范增强流程中，为移动操作的数据高效泛化提供了新思路。

title: InstantHand: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Animatable Hand Avatar Reconstruction from a Single Image
abstract: Hand avatar reconstruction typically relies on multi-view capture or per-subject optimization, limiting its scalability. We introduce InstantHand, a feed-forward framework that constructs an animatable 3D Gaussian hand avatar from a single image using off-the-shelf MANO, camera, and mask estimates, without test-time optimization. Image-averaged losses provide insufficient supervision for alpha leakage, which thickens thin finger contours. To address this issue, we propose a Soft Alpha Band regularizer that concentrates supervision on silhouette boundaries. Furthermore, colors regressed from image features can drift toward a learned prior even in observed regions. Our Reliability-gated Appearance Transfer preserves observed appearance by transferring source colors according to each Gaussian's rendering contribution, while completing unobserved regions using the learned prior conditioned on global source identity. InstantHand constructs an avatar in 2.84 seconds and renders at 161 FPS, matching per-subject-optimized baselines on InterHand2.6M and remaining competitive in zero-shot evaluation on HanCo.
tldr: InstantHand 从单张图像前馈重建可动画手部高斯化身，无需测试时优化。
motivation: 手部化身重建通常依赖多视角采集或逐受试者优化，限制了可扩展性。单图像前馈重建面临轮廓监督不足导致 alpha 泄漏、细手指变粗，以及外观颜色在观测区域仍向学习先验漂移的问题。
method: InstantHand 利用现成 MANO、相机与掩码估计，从单张图像前馈构建可动画 3D Gaussian 手部化身，无需测试时优化。提出 Soft Alpha Band 正则将监督集中在轮廓边界以抑制 alpha 泄漏；提出 Reliability-gated Appearance Transfer，按每个 Gaussian 的渲染贡献转移源颜色以保留观测外观，并以全局源身份为条件用学习先验补全未观测区域。
result: InstantHand 在 2.84 秒内构建化身并以 161 FPS 渲染，在 InterHand2.6M 上匹配逐受试者优化基线，在 HanCo 零样本评估中保持竞争力。
conclusion: 该方法实现了无需测试时优化的单图像可动画手部化身重建，并具备高效推理能力。Soft Alpha Band 正则与 Reliability-gated Appearance Transfer 分别缓解轮廓泄漏和外观漂移，为可扩展的手部化身创建提供了新思路。

title: Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting for Online Reconstruction
abstract: Online 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs a scene during capture: each keyframe spawns primitives once and refines them for only a few dozen iterations, leaving little chance to fix poor initialization or missing detail. Gaussians are also inherently soft, needing many overlaps for solid surfaces. We present Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting (HIBS), which brings beta kernels to incremental reconstruction. Their shape parameter interpolates between a soft, Gaussian-like profile and a flat-topped, near-opaque surfel, acting as a confidence dial for geometry. Our confidence-aware spawning uses geometric observability and multi-view depth agreement to initialize both opacity and shape, producing solid primitives where geometry is verifiable and soft, correctable primitives where it is not. As online densification, error-driven relocation recycles stale primitives into photometric-error hotspots. Bounded beta kernel support enables exact tile culling and faster rasterization, and a closed-form, shape-preserving merging formulation provides a level-of-detail (LOD) hierarchy for fast optimization and real-time rendering. On Mip-NeRF 360 in the on-the-fly protocol, HIBS improves PSNR by up to 0.8 dB while reducing optimization time by up to 40%. Project page: https://linus-franke.com/hibs/
tldr: HIBS将beta核引入在线增量重建，通过置信度初始化与LOD合并提升质量并加速优化。
motivation: 在线3D高斯泼溅在采集过程中重建场景，每个关键帧仅生成一次原语且只优化几十次，难以修正较差初始化或补充缺失细节；同时高斯原语偏软，需要大量重叠才能形成实体表面。
method: HIBS将beta核引入增量重建，其形状参数可在软高斯轮廓与近平顶不透明surfel之间插值，作为几何置信度调节。置信度感知生成利用几何可观测性和多视角深度一致性初始化不透明度与形状；误差驱动重定位将陈旧原语回收至光度误差热点，并通过有界支撑实现精确tile剔除、闭式保形合并构建LOD层次。
result: 在Mip-NeRF 360的on-the-fly协议下，HIBS将PSNR最高提升0.8 dB，同时将优化时间最多减少40%，并支持更快光栅化与实时渲染。
conclusion: HIBS为在线重建提供了可调软硬度的beta splatting表示与LOD层次，在提升重建质量的同时显著加速优化，具备实时渲染应用潜力。

title: How Far Can Untrained Neural Networks Go in Anomaly Detection? From Tables to Pixels
abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) is often framed as a representation-learning problem, where strong performance is expected to require learned features or AD-specific optimization. However, this view can overlook the intrinsic separability of anomalies from normal references, even in the absence of learned representations. We therefore investigate how far untrained neural networks can go in anomaly detection. To this end, we propose PRISM, a framework combining fixed random nonlinear features with normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring for tabular detection and dense visual localization. Across 47 tabular datasets in ADBench, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC (86.4%) and the second-highest mean AUPRC (65.9%) among the compared methods. On MVTec AD and VisA, covering 27 visual categories, PRISM-V achieves mean image-level and pixel-level AUROCs of 90.4% and 96.4%, respectively. Notably, both models achieve these results without neural weight optimization or pretrained representations. A theoretical analysis further characterizes how nonlinear transformations affect the mean and covariance contributions to the Mahalanobis score gap, while empirical analyses examine the resulting score separability. These findings establish PRISM as both a competitive anomaly detector and a prior-to-learning baseline for assessing the added value of learned representations in anomaly detection.
tldr: PRISM用固定随机非线性特征与正态参考马氏评分，在无训练和无预训练表征下实现表格与图像异常检测。
motivation: 异常检测常被视为表征学习问题，并默认强性能依赖学习特征或面向异常检测的专门优化，这可能忽视异常相对正常参考本身的可分性。作者因此研究无训练神经网络在异常检测中能达到什么程度。
method: 提出PRISM框架，将固定的随机非线性特征与基于正常参考的马氏距离评分结合；PRISM-T用于表格异常检测，PRISM-V用于密集视觉定位。整个方法不进行神经权重优化，也不使用预训练表征，并从理论上分析非线性变换如何影响马氏评分差距中的均值与协方差贡献。
result: 在ADBench的47个表格数据集上，PRISM-T取得最高平均AUROC 86.4%和次高平均AUPRC 65.9%；在覆盖27个类别的MVTec AD与VisA上，PRISM-V取得平均图像级和像素级AUROC 90.4%与96.4%。
conclusion: 结果表明，无需学习权重或预训练表征的PRISM仍是有竞争力的异常检测器，同时可作为“学习之前”的基线，用于评估学习表征在异常检测中的增益，并揭示异常与正常参考之间的内在可分性。

title: Rotation Is Token-Blind: A Structural Criterion for Post-Training Quantization of Feed-Forward Geometry Transformers
abstract: Feed-forward 3D models use Transformers to predict camera poses, depth, and structure in one pass, avoiding iterative multi-view optimization. Long sequences and deep attention incur high compute and memory costs, motivating Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) for deployment. Existing PTQ methods mainly suppress channel-wise outliers by smoothing or orthogonal rotation. Geometry Transformers introduce a different challenge: heterogeneous token types share one activation quantization grid. A few special tokens may exert high leverage over global outputs and be updated by only a subset of blocks. Token-blind transforms, which apply the same transformation to every token, reduce overall quantization error but cannot remove differentiated degradation across token types. We propose QMapAnything, a structure-aware PTQ framework. We cast floating-point-preserving rotation and smoothing as a token-blind reparameterization group, and prove that they yield common-mode gains while leaving relative token SNR unchanged. We introduce a statistic $Γ$ that combines a special token's quantization disadvantage and output leverage to predict whether differentiated bias correction is needed beyond rotation. Experiments on geometric benchmarks show that W4A8 closely matches full-precision performance. Under W8A8, peak memory falls by $2.2$--$3.1\times$ versus FP32, with up to $3.1\times$ speedup on real hardware. These results provide a principled and efficient approach to deploying feed-forward 3D reconstruction models in resource-constrained edges.
tldr: 提出结构感知PTQ框架QMapAnything，用Γ统计量判断几何Transformer是否需要差异化偏差校正。
motivation: 前馈式3D模型用Transformer一次预测相机位姿、深度与结构，但长序列和深层注意力带来高计算与内存开销，需要PTQ以便部署。现有PTQ主要通过平滑或正交旋转抑制通道级离群值，而几何Transformer中异构token类型共享同一激活量化网格，少数特殊token对全局输出影响大且仅由部分模块更新，token-blind变换无法消除不同token类型间的差异化退化。
method: 提出结构感知PTQ框架QMapAnything，将保浮点旋转和平滑建模为token-blind重参数化群，并证明其只带来共模增益而不会改变相对token信噪比。进一步引入统计量Γ，结合特殊token的量化劣势与输出杠杆，预测在旋转之外是否需要差异化偏差校正。
result: 在几何基准上，W4A8量化性能与全精度接近；W8A8下峰值内存相比FP32降低2.2–3.1倍，在真实硬件上最高取得3.1倍加速。
conclusion: 结果表明该方法是部署前馈式3D重建模型到资源受限边缘设备的原则性且高效方案，为几何Transformer的PTQ提供了结构感知的新准则。

title: EDGAR: Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement via Synthetic Failure
abstract: Recent advances in Gaussian splatting have enabled efficient and photorealistic head avatar reconstruction, yet monocular video-based or image-based methods still suffer from under-constrained geometry and texture, leading to artifacts such as blurring, stretching, and temporal instability. We present EDGAR (Efficient Diffusion-Driven Gaussian Avatar Refinement), a conditional diffusion framework designed to enhance the quality of Gaussian avatars by correcting artifacts while preserving identity fidelity. To train EDGAR, we construct EDGAR-SET, a hybrid triplet dataset composed of real-captured and synthetic-rendered samples, which simulates realistic Gaussian avatar failure cases by pairing degraded renderings with ground-truth and reference images. EDGAR refines degraded frames through a fusion block that injects identity features extracted by the self-supervised Sapiens model into a one-step diffusion backbone, enabling effective artifact removal without sacrificing efficiency. Our EDGAR model incorporates a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture to address diverse degradation types and severity levels. The refined multi-view renderings are subsequently used as pseudo-targets to optimize a single underlying Gaussian avatar, so that the final avatar can be rendered without applying EDGAR to every output frame. Experiments on three different Gaussian avatar reconstruction methods, each evaluated under three different settings, show improvements in both perceptual and reconstruction measures over the raw outputs and an SDEdit-style refinement baseline. In addition, cross-view evaluation demonstrates improved calibrated consistency, while tests under large yaw and open-mouth expressions verify robustness under extreme settings. These results collectively indicate a useful operating regime for recoverable appearance artifacts. The code is available at https://kwanyun.github.io/edgar/
tldr: EDGAR 用单步扩散与身份特征融合修复高斯头像伪影，并以多视图伪目标优化单一高斯头像。
motivation: 单目视频或图像驱动的高斯头像重建受几何与纹理约束不足影响，容易出现模糊、拉伸和时序不稳定等伪影。研究目标是在保持身份一致性的前提下有效校正这些退化，并提升最终高斯头像的渲染质量。
method: 作者构建了融合真实采集与合成渲染的 EDGAR-SET 三元组数据集，通过将退化渲染与真值、参考图像配对来模拟高斯头像失败案例。EDGAR 将 Sapiens 自监督模型提取的身份特征注入一步扩散骨干的融合块，并采用 Mixture-of-Experts 架构应对不同退化类型与严重程度；精修后的多视图渲染作为伪目标优化单一底层高斯头像，从而避免对每帧输出都运行扩散模型。
result: 在三种高斯头像重建方法、每种方法三种设置下，EDGAR 在感知与重建指标上均优于原始输出和 SDEdit 式精修基线；跨视角评估显示校准一致性提升，大偏航角和张嘴表情测试验证了极端条件下的鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 结果表明 EDGAR 为可恢复的外观伪影提供了一种有效工作区间，其贡献包括高效扩散驱动的头像精修框架、合成失败样本数据集以及基于多视图伪目标的单高斯头像优化策略，代码已开源。

title: XM4D: 4D Reconstruction through Certifiable Geometric Optimization
abstract: Accurate 4D reconstruction remains challenging: jointly estimating camera motion, scene geometry, and non-rigid deformation entails highly nonconvex optimization, making global optimality difficult to guarantee. We present XM4D, a framework for accurate and efficient 4D reconstruction built upon certifiably globally optimal geometric optimization. By separating the estimation of camera motion from non-rigid deformation, we formulate both stages as structured quadratically constrained quadratic programs (QCQP) that admit semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxations and verifiable global optimality certificates. For camera motion estimation, we lift static point tracks into 3D using foundational depth prediction models and formulate a scaled bundle adjustment problem that jointly estimates camera poses, depth scales, and static landmarks. By analytically eliminating translations and landmarks, we reduce the problem to a QCQP over scaled rotations. For non-rigid reconstruction, we represent dynamic motion using an embedded deformation graph (EDG) and show that its tracking, rigidity, and temporal regularization objectives similarly reduce to a rotation-only QCQP. Both problems admit SDP relaxations that we solve efficiently with a GPU-accelerated Burer-Monteiro solver based on Riemannian optimization. The recovered geometry further initializes dynamic Gaussian splatting for photometric refinement. Extensive experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate accurate camera motion estimation on both static and dynamic scenes, efficient optimization that scales to thousands of frames, and state-of-the-art novel-view rendering quality.
tldr: XM4D通过可认证全局最优几何优化分离相机运动与非刚性形变，实现高效准确4D重建。
motivation: 4D重建需联合估计相机运动、场景几何与非刚性形变，该问题高度非凸，现有方法难以保证全局最优性，亟需兼顾精度、效率与可认证性的优化框架。
method: XM4D将相机运动估计与非刚性形变分离，并分别建模为结构化QCQP，通过SDP松弛获得可验证全局最优证书。相机阶段利用基础深度模型将静态点轨提升至3D，构建联合估计位姿、深度尺度和静态路标的scaled bundle adjustment，解析消元后化为旋转QCQP；非刚性阶段用EDG表示动态运动，将跟踪、刚性和时序正则化为旋转-only QCQP，并用GPU加速的Burer-Monteiro黎曼优化求解，恢复几何再初始化动态Gaussian splatting进行光度细化。
result: 在7个基准上实验表明，方法在静态和动态场景均能准确估计相机运动，优化效率可扩展至数千帧，并取得state-of-the-art的新视角渲染质量；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: 论文贡献在于将4D重建中的非凸联合优化转化为两阶段可认证全局最优的旋转QCQP/SDP问题，并与动态Gaussian splatting结合，为高精度、可扩展的4D重建提供了新路线。

title: STAG-Net: Structure-Aware Attention over Landmark Groups for Lightweight Head Pose Estimation
abstract: Head pose estimation is important for human computer interaction and driver monitoring, but many image based methods remain too costly for resource constrained deployment. We propose STAG-Net, a structure-aware attention over landmark groups for lightweight head Pose estimation that estimates head pose from facial landmarks using movement aware selection, spatial clustering, compact DeepSet encoders, self attention, and a global geometry descriptor. We develop variants using FaceMesh and Face Alignment Network landmarks and evaluate them under cross dataset and subject independent protocols on 300W-LP, AFLW2000, and BIWI. STAG-Net achieves the lowest mean absolute error among all compared landmark based methods in every evaluated setting. On BIWI frames with valid detections, the FAN variant also records the lowest overall error among all compared methods, reaching $3.51^\circ$ under cross dataset evaluation and $2.39^\circ$ under subject independent evaluation. The regressors use only 0.012 to 0.043 million parameters and 24.1 to 83.6 thousand FLOPs, about three orders of magnitude fewer FLOPs than FSA-Net. Despite including landmark extraction and regression, the FaceMesh pipeline reaches 322.9 frames per second on a Tesla T4 GPU, nearly twice the 164.5 frames per second of the fastest measured image based baseline, and 111.0 frames per second on CPU. After normalization by dataset size, STAG-Net processes training samples seven to eight times faster than FSA-Net and more than one hundred times faster than HopeNet and TokenHPE, while complete training finishes within 28 minutes. These results show that STAG-Net combines leading landmark based accuracy with substantially lower training and inference cost.
tldr: STAG-Net利用面部关键点分组结构注意力实现轻量高精度头部姿态估计。
motivation: 许多基于图像的头部姿态估计方法计算成本高，难以部署在资源受限设备上；研究旨在利用面部关键点，在保证精度的同时显著降低训练与推理开销。
method: STAG-Net采用运动感知选择、空间聚类、紧凑DeepSet编码器、自注意力机制和全局几何描述符，对关键点分组进行结构感知建模，并基于FaceMesh与Face Alignment Network关键点构建两种变体。
result: 在300W-LP、AFLW2000和BIWI上的跨数据集与subject independent协议中，STAG-Net在所有对比的基于关键点方法中取得最低MAE；BIWI有效检测帧上FAN变体分别达到3.51°和2.39°。回归器仅0.012至0.043百万参数、24.1至83.6千FLOPs，FLOPs比FSA-Net少约三个数量级；FaceMesh流水线在Tesla T4上达322.9 FPS、CPU上达111.0 FPS，完整训练在28分钟内完成。
conclusion: STAG-Net在基于关键点的方法中实现了领先精度，同时大幅降低推理FLOPs和训练时间，展示了在资源受限场景下部署轻量头部姿态估计的潜力。

title: AffineGS: Unlocking Accurate Geometry in 3DGS via Spatially Varying Affine Rectification
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become the leading approach for photorealistic novel view synthesis, yet its geometric accuracy lags behind its visual quality. Existing depth-guided methods attempt to resolve this by regularizing the optimization with monocular depth priors, typically using a single global scale-and-shift alignment. Crucially, we discover a fundamental flaw in this assumption: modern monocular depth networks systematically exhibit region-dependent, piecewise-linear distortions. This discovery invalidates standard global alignment strategies, which warp scene geometry by enforcing a single transform. To address this, we introduce a spatially varying affine rectification model that corrects monocular disparity into consistent metric depth using regionally smooth, edge-aware fields. We further derive a normal-aware regularizer that uses spatial gradients to couple the rectified disparity with 3DGS depth and normals. Across diverse experimental settings, our sensor-free method shows strong photometric quality of Gaussian Splatting while substantially improving geometric accuracy and outperforming state-of-the art geometry-focused methods.
tldr: 提出空间变化仿射矫正，修正单目深度分段线性畸变，显著提升3DGS几何精度。
motivation: 3DGS在新视角合成中视觉效果突出，但几何精度不足；现有深度引导方法通常采用全局尺度与偏移对齐单目深度先验。作者发现现代单目深度网络存在区域相关的分段线性畸变，使全局对齐假设失效并扭曲场景几何。
method: 提出空间变化仿射矫正模型，利用区域平滑且边缘感知的场将单目视差校正为一致的度量深度；进一步推导法向感知正则项，通过空间梯度将矫正后的视差与3DGS的深度和法向耦合优化。
result: 在多种实验设置下，该无传感器方法在保持3DGS强光度质量的同时大幅提升几何精度，并优于当前面向几何精度的先进方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 工作揭示了单目深度先验的全局对齐缺陷，提出空间变化仿射矫正与法向感知正则化，为无传感器3DGS几何重建提供更准确的优化框架，对高质量场景重建与下游几何应用具有潜在影响。

title: Georeferenced Cross-View 3D Reconstruction from Ground and Satellite Images
abstract: Georeferenced 3D reconstruction from ground images requires recovering not only the local scene geometry, but also localizing every camera center and 3D point in a geographic coordinate frame. Existing cross-view geo-localization methods are able to estimate the GPS coordinate of a single ground camera, but do not reconstruct dense 3D geometry, while recent feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction models predict point maps and camera poses only in a local coordinate frame. We introduce X-VGGT, a feed-forward cross-view geometry transformer that unifies these tasks by jointly processing a set of ground-level images and a georeferenced satellite image to predict ground-view camera poses, dense 3D point maps, and a scene-level transform parameterized by gravity, scale, yaw and translation. This transform projects the local reconstruction into the satellite plane, resulting in the geo-registration of all ground images with the georeferenced satellite image. We further propose an evaluation protocol for this joint task and show that, across multiple cross-view datasets, X-VGGT produces accurate georeferenced reconstructions and outperforms prior cross-view geo-localization and multi-view 3D reconstruction models.
tldr: X-VGGT联合地面与卫星图像，前馈预测位姿和稠密点图并完成地理配准三维重建。
motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法仅能估计单张地面相机的GPS坐标，无法重建稠密三维几何；而前馈多视图重建模型只在局部坐标系中预测点图和相机位姿，缺乏地理配准。本文旨在联合恢复地面场景几何，并将所有相机中心与三维点定位到地理坐标系中。
method: 提出X-VGGT，一种前馈跨视角几何Transformer，联合处理一组地面图像与一幅带地理参考的卫星图像，预测地面相机位姿、稠密三维点图以及由重力、尺度、偏航和平移参数化的场景级变换。该变换将局部重建投影到卫星平面，从而实现所有地面图像与地理参考卫星图像的地理配准；同时提出该联合任务的评测协议。
result: 摘要在多个跨视角数据集上验证X-VGGT能生成准确的地理配准重建，并优于先前的跨视角地理定位和多视图三维重建模型；但未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: X-VGGT将跨视角地理定位与稠密三维重建统一到前馈框架中，实现地面图像与卫星图像联合的地理参考三维重建，并给出联合任务评测协议。该工作为城市建模、测绘和空间感知等应用提供了新思路。

title: MetricTrail: Revisiting the Power of Metric Depth and Local Optimization for Long-Sequence Streaming 3D Reconstruction
abstract: We present MetricTrail, a streaming system for accurate camera motion estimation and dense reconstruction from long monocular videos. To keep inference efficient over long sequences, we revisit DPVO's sparse local estimator. We find that single-image metric depth substantially improves its trajectory accuracy, without retraining the correspondence network or enlarging the optimization window. Metric predictions initialize patch depths and remain as soft constraints during optimization. We further improve correspondence estimation through learned adapters that augment matching features and recurrent context with frozen DINOv3 representations. The correspondence estimator and adapters are trained on diverse short clips without additional long-sequence training. This modular design also allows the depth provider to be independently upgraded and supports supplied camera intrinsics and calibrated stereo observations without retraining. Under the reported RGB-only protocols, MetricTrail achieves the lowest average trajectory error among evaluated methods on KITTI, Oxford Spires, and VBR. Pairing the estimated poses with single-image depth predictions also produces strong dense reconstruction on indoor and outdoor benchmarks and coherent reconstructions of in-the-wild videos. With supplied intrinsics, the system processes KITTI-02 at 12.70 FPS with 3.21 GB peak GPU memory.
tldr: MetricTrail 利用单目度量深度与局部优化实现长序列流式三维重建，并取得更低轨迹误差。
motivation: 长单目视频流式重建需在有限算力下同时保持相机轨迹与稠密重建精度；现有稀疏局部估计器在长序列中轨迹精度受限，且深度与对应估计模块耦合，难以独立升级或利用外部相机参数。
method: 方法重新审视 DPVO 的稀疏局部估计器，用单图像度量深度初始化 patch 深度并在优化中作为软约束，从而不重训对应网络、不扩大优化窗口即可提升轨迹精度；同时用基于冻结 DINOv3 表示的 learned adapters 增强匹配特征与循环上下文，且仅在多样短片段上训练。模块化设计使深度提供者可独立升级，并支持给定相机内参与标定双目观测而无需重训。
result: 在报告的 RGB-only 协议下，MetricTrail 在 KITTI、Oxford Spires 和 VBR 上取得所评估方法中最低的平均轨迹误差；将估计位姿与单图像深度预测结合，在室内外基准上获得强稠密重建，并对 in-the-wild 视频生成连贯重建。给定内参时，系统处理 KITTI-02 达 12.70 FPS，峰值 GPU 显存 3.21 GB。
conclusion: 结果表明，将度量深度作为初始化与软约束并结合局部优化，可在不重训对应网络、不扩大优化窗口的情况下显著提升长序列流式重建的轨迹与稠密重建质量。其模块化设计便于深度模块升级并支持内参与标定双目输入，对实时长视频三维重建具有实用价值。

title: Degree-Equalized View-Graph Selection under Tight Pair Budgets
abstract: Fully matching all image pairs in Structure-from-Motion is quadratic in the number of images, so practical pipelines pass a budgeted subset to the final matching and reconstruction backend. One-shot selectors score candidates with image retrieval, cheap geometric probes, or a learned prior and finalize B pairs before full matching. Their priorities do not account for the degree already allocated to each image, which can concentrate edges on a few images. Across nine large 1DSfM internet photo collections at B=2N, the coverage top-B selector leaves 54% of covered images with realized degree at most two. Reconstruction can then fail even when the selected graph is nearly connected and almost fully verified. Our training-free greedy rule, Degree-Equalized Allocation (DEAL), exponentially downweights pairs whose endpoints are already well covered. On these collections, DEAL improves the one-shot selector built on the same prior (from 0.776 to 0.929) and matches the mean registered-image ratio of an SfM-supervised edge prior under the shared backend (0.929 vs 0.930), without training. On the largely saturated 38-scene standard benchmark suite, DEAL gives the highest mean among the evaluated training-free selectors (0.875 vs 0.858 one-shot).
tldr: DEAL 通过按已覆盖度数指数降权图像对，在紧预算下均衡视图图并提升 SfM 配准覆盖率。
motivation: SfM 全量图像对匹配的复杂度随图像数二次增长，实际流程通常只将预算受限的图像对子集送入匹配与重建后端。现有一次性选择器按检索、几何探测或学习先验打分，却不考虑各图像已分配度数，容易把边集中在少数图像上，导致即使图近似连通且验证充分，重建仍可能失败。
method: 提出免训练贪心规则 Degree-Equalized Allocation（DEAL），在选边时对端点已被充分覆盖的图像对进行指数降权，将有限配对预算分散到更多图像。该方法可作为通用分配规则与现有先验或一次性选择器结合，无需额外训练。
result: 在 9 个 1DSfM 互联网照片集且 B=2N 时，coverage top-B 选择器使 54% 的已覆盖图像实际度数不超过 2。DEAL 将同一先验下的一次性选择器配准图像比例从 0.776 提升到 0.929，并在共享后端下以 0.929 对 0.930 匹配 SfM 监督边先验且无需训练；在 38 场景标准基准上，DEAL 在免训练选择器中取得最高均值 0.875，对比一次性选择器 0.858。
conclusion: 结果表明紧配对预算下应显式考虑图像度数均衡，DEAL 以简单、免训练的方式显著改善视图图覆盖与 SfM 配准表现。该方法易于集成到现有 SfM 流程，对大规模互联网照片重建具有实用价值。

title: Compact Motion Embeddings for Feed-forward Unified Human Animation
abstract: Animating a reference image with a driver's motion requires a motion representation that captures face, hand, and body articulation but excludes the driver's appearance. Most body animation methods take motion from external pose estimators and render it with many denoising steps; compact learned motion representations mostly cover the face. We present FUHA, a real-time-capable feed-forward transformer that learns a compact motion embedding of the whole human and uses it for face, upper-body, and full-body animation. A Q-Former compresses the driver's features from a frozen visual encoder into this embedding. To disentangle motion from appearance, a novel contrastive loss pulls it toward the motion embedding of the driver's rendered keypoint image and away from that of the same person in another pose. At inference time, FUHA needs no external pose estimators, keypoints, or parametric body models. As a retrieval key, the motion embedding matches body pose better than the learned global embeddings of ten vision encoders. Its same-person retrieval rate is 0.1%, against 9.5% for its own DINOv3 backbone. On our upper-body benchmark, FUHA outperforms all baselines on every self-reenactment metric and on cross-reenactment identity similarity. It is competitive on face and full-body and runs at up to 38.9 FPS at 512x512 on a single RTX 4090.
tldr: FUHA学习全人体紧凑运动嵌入，无需外部姿态估计即可前馈实时驱动人脸、上半身和全身动画。
motivation: 现有全身动画方法通常依赖外部姿态估计器并需要多步去噪渲染，而学习到的紧凑运动表示大多只覆盖面部。论文旨在构建一种能捕获面部、手部和身体关节运动、同时排除驱动者外观的全人体紧凑运动表示。
method: 提出FUHA，一种可实时运行的前馈Transformer，使用Q-Former将冻结视觉编码器提取的驱动者特征压缩为全人体运动嵌入。为解耦运动与外观，引入对比损失，使该嵌入靠近驱动者渲染关键点图像的运动嵌入，并远离同一人物另一姿态的运动嵌入；推理时无需外部姿态估计器、关键点或参数化人体模型。
result: 作为检索键，该运动嵌入在身体姿态匹配上优于十个视觉编码器的学习全局嵌入，同人检索率为0.1%，而其DINOv3骨干为9.5%。在上半身基准上，FUHA在所有自重现指标和跨重现身份相似度上均优于所有基线，在面部和全身任务上具有竞争力，并在单张RTX 4090上以512x512分辨率达到最高38.9 FPS。
conclusion: FUHA证明了紧凑全人体运动嵌入可用于统一的人脸、上半身和全身前馈动画，并在无需外部姿态估计的情况下实现实时推理。其贡献在于提出有效的运动-外观解耦表示与统一动画框架，为高效实时人体动画提供了新路线。

title: FREE-LIVO: Physically Decoupled Yet Tightly Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry
abstract: LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) integrates complementary LiDAR, camera, and IMU measurements to achieve robust state estimation. However, most existing methods assume a fixed relative pose and accurate time synchronization between sensors. Toward modular and heterogeneous robotic systems, this paper presents FREE-LIVO, a tightly coupled odometry method that requires neither a rigid LiDAR-camera rig nor LiDAR-camera time synchronization. The proposed method uses a pretrained image feature matcher to establish correspondences between a camera image and a dense LiDAR intensity image generated from a single LiDAR scan using a generative model. From the resulting 3D point-to-pixel correspondences, we construct reprojection factors that directly constrain LiDAR and camera poses at different acquisition times. These factors are jointly optimized in a single factor graph together with constraints from point cloud registration, visual feature tracking, and the IMU measurements associated with each sensor. On six sequences from the public M3DGR dataset, FREE-LIVO achieves an average absolute trajectory error (ATE) RMSE of 0.45 m without provided LiDAR-camera extrinsic parameters and exhibits minimal accuracy degradation under time synchronization errors of up to 0.5 s. Furthermore, experiments with the LiDAR and camera mounted on separate robots demonstrate that the method can jointly estimate the trajectories of independently moving sensors.
tldr: FREE-LIVO无需刚性外参和时间同步，借跨模态匹配构建重投影因子实现紧耦合LIVO。
motivation: 现有LIVO多假设传感器间相对位姿固定且时间同步准确，难以适应模块化和异构机器人系统。本文旨在无需刚性LiDAR-相机支架、也无需LiDAR-相机时间同步的条件下实现紧耦合LIVO。
method: 利用预训练图像特征匹配器在相机图像与由单帧LiDAR扫描经生成模型得到的稠密LiDAR强度图像间建立对应关系。由3D点-像素对应构建重投影因子，直接约束不同采集时刻的LiDAR与相机位姿，并与点云配准、视觉特征跟踪及各传感器关联的IMU测量在统一因子图中联合优化。
result: 在公开M3DGR数据集的六个序列上，无需提供LiDAR-相机外参时平均ATE RMSE为0.45 m；在最高0.5 s时间同步误差下精度下降很小。LiDAR与相机分属不同机器人时，仍能联合估计独立运动传感器的轨迹。
conclusion: 提出物理解耦但紧耦合的FREE-LIVO，摆脱刚性LiDAR-相机支架与时间同步依赖，在统一因子图中联合优化跨模态重投影、点云配准、视觉跟踪和IMU约束。该工作提升模块化异构机器人系统的部署灵活性，并支持多机器人/独立运动传感器联合定位。

title: Procedural Adversarial Learning
abstract: For many computer vision tasks, neural networks can be trained to produce a low average error, yet they still fail on seemingly simple scenes. Reducing these failures requires first finding them, but they may not be in a fixed dataset. We study procedural adversarial learning (PAL), a framework of minimax training and adversarial evaluation which searches the input space of a procedural generator for difficult instances. The procedural generator is an interpretable program mapping a low-dimensional vector of control parameters (e.g. layout, lighting, pose) to a rendered image and its label. We introduce the Simple-PAT algorithm, which uses zeroth-order optimization in the procedural generator's parameter space to propose adversarial training samples that are generated on demand. We also create PAL-Dojo, a collection of efficient procedural generators for surface normal estimation, image segmentation, and human pose estimation. Against a cross-model black-box adversary with 50M aggregate queries, Simple-PAT reduces worst-case error by a geometric mean of 3.15x compared to standard training and 2.63x compared to the strongest robust training baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/princeton-vl/procedural-adversarial-learning.
tldr: 提出PAL框架与Simple-PAT，利用程序化生成器搜索困难样本并提升视觉模型最坏情况鲁棒性。
motivation: 神经网络在计算机视觉任务中常取得较低平均误差，但在看似简单的场景仍会失败；这些失败样本未必存在于固定数据集中，因此需要主动搜索困难实例以降低失败率。
method: PAL 将 minimax 训练与对抗评估结合，在可解释程序化生成器的低维控制参数空间（布局、光照、姿态等）中搜索困难实例；Simple-PAT 使用零阶优化在参数空间按需生成对抗训练样本，并构建 PAL-Dojo 程序化生成器集合，覆盖表面法向估计、图像分割和人体姿态估计任务。
result: 在跨模型黑盒攻击（总计 5000 万次查询）下，Simple-PAT 将最坏情况误差几何平均降低 3.15 倍（相比标准训练）和 2.63 倍（相比最强鲁棒训练基线）。
conclusion: PAL 通过程序化对抗学习把困难样本搜索与鲁棒训练结合，Simple-PAT 在无需固定对抗样本集的情况下显著改善最坏情况性能；PAL-Dojo 为多任务鲁棒性评估提供可解释、可扩展的基准与训练环境。

title: Trainspotting: Learning Object-Centric 3D Reconstruction from Found Photos
abstract: State-of-the-art feedforward reconstruction models perform poorly on in-the-wild object-centric photo collections. They are trained largely on single-session object captures whose images vary in viewpoint while the object and its environment remain nearly fixed. Public photo archives contain a different form of multi-view data. They hold found photos of the same object or design: photos taken independently by many people across years, environments, cameras, and sometimes physical units. In this work, we introduce Trainspotting, a dataset of 12,068 objects and 311,886 photos from Wikimedia Commons. We reconstruct each object to recover camera poses, multi-view stereo depth, and object masks. We categorize the objects into three regimes: objects fixed at one site, objects that move between sites, and designs shared by many physical units. Evaluating recent feedforward reconstruction models on Trainspotting shows that they fail most severely in the last two regimes. Fine-tuning VGGT-$Ω$ on Trainspotting significantly improves camera pose, depth, and 3D geometry on held-out objects. We observe similar improvements on the independent NAVI in-the-wild benchmark, which contains photos of each object in different environments. Performance on conventional benchmarks remains largely unchanged.
tldr: 提出Trainspotting数据集，用野生照片提升对象中心三维重建在跨环境场景的鲁棒性。
motivation: 现有前馈重建模型多在单次对象拍摄数据上训练，难以处理公众照片档案中跨年份、环境、相机乃至不同实物单元的多视角数据；在物体移动或设计由多实物共享的场景下性能显著下降。
method: 构建Trainspotting数据集，包含Wikimedia Commons的12,068个对象和311,886张照片，并恢复相机位姿、多视角立体深度与对象掩码；按物体固定、跨地点移动、设计共享多实物三种情形分类。基于该数据微调VGGT-Ω。
result: 实验表明近期前馈重建模型在后两种情形下失败最严重；微调VGGT-Ω后在留出对象上的相机位姿、深度和三维几何显著提升，并在NAVI in-the-wild基准取得类似改进，而常规基准性能基本不变。
conclusion: 该工作提供了面向found photos的对象中心三维重建数据集与训练策略，提升了跨环境、跨实例重建泛化能力，对利用公共照片档案进行三维重建具有推动意义。

title: Smartphone-Aided VR Exergames for HIIT: Gamifying Fitness with Real-Time Pose Estimation
abstract:
This paper introduces an innovative virtual reality (VR) exergame system designed to gamify High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) workouts through 11 predefined combo moves, including squat-punch combinations, bilateral arm strikes, and diagonal stretch combos. Unlike conventional tracking methods that often rely on wearable motion capture suits or limited headset-based sensors, our system uses a standard smartphone camera placed on a tripod to capture full-body movement. This approach offers a cost-effective and scalable alternative, particularly well-suited to the fast, dynamic motions typical of HIIT routines.
  The smartphone footage is processed in real time using a pose estimation algorithm, with extracted biomechanical data analyzed by a backend server built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Anthropic's open standard for connecting AI models to structured data sources and tools, and a GPT-4o large language model. The system generates personalized assessments of form accuracy, movement efficiency, exercise intensity, and potential injury risks, tailored specifically to high-impact, time-sensitive exercises.
  A within-subject study involving 20 participants (ages 18-25) compared experiences in VR and Non-VR HIIT sessions. Results indicated significantly higher enjoyment (Mean = 3.5 vs 2.8, p = 0.02), improved immersion/focus (Mean = 3.2 vs 2.8, p = 0.03), and increased likelihood to recommend (Mean = 3.2 vs 2.7, p = 0.04) under the VR condition. Confidence to continue did not differ significantly between conditions (p = 0.15), while perceived intensity remained comparable. The MCP system showed strong agreement with expert evaluation (87.5%, N = 10 sessions, one certified trainer), supporting its reliability as a feedback tool.
tldr: 基于手机姿态估计与GPT-4o的VR HIIT健身游戏，提升享受感与沉浸感，反馈与专家高度一致。
motivation: 传统动作追踪常依赖可穿戴动捕服或受限的头显传感器，难以低成本、可扩展地支持HIIT中快速动态的动作。本文旨在用普通智能手机摄像头实现全身动作捕捉，并将HIIT训练游戏化。
method: 系统包含11个预设组合动作，使用三脚架上的手机摄像头采集全身运动，实时进行姿态估计并提取生物力学数据；后端基于MCP协议与GPT-4o生成对动作规范、运动效率、训练强度和受伤风险的个性化评估。研究采用20名18-25岁参与者的被试内设计，对比VR与非VR HIIT体验。
result: VR条件下享受感显著更高（均值3.5 vs 2.8，p=0.02），沉浸/专注更高（3.2 vs 2.8，p=0.03），推荐意愿更高（3.2 vs 2.7，p=0.04）；继续训练信心无显著差异（p=0.15），感知强度相当。MCP系统与专家评估一致率达87.5%（N=10次训练，1名认证教练）。
conclusion: 结果表明，基于手机姿态估计与LLM/MCP反馈的VR HIIT exergame能以低成本提升训练享受感、沉浸感和推荐意愿，并提供与专家较一致的实时评估。该系统为可扩展的家庭健身与高强度间歇训练游戏化提供了可行路径。

title: SpikePose: Lightweight Video Human Pose Estimation
abstract: Efficient video human pose estimation must balance localisation accuracy, motion quality, and energy cost. We present SpikePose, a lightweight video pose estimator that pairs a frame-reset, single-step spiking encoder with motion-aligned heatmap memory (MAM). The encoder supplies per-frame spatial evidence, while MAM estimates joint displacement, aligns historical heatmaps, and adaptively fuses them with current predictions. By confining temporal reasoning to a compact, lightweight module outside the spiking backbone, SpikePose helps bridge the gap between spiking and classical Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) on large-scale, non-event-driven video tasks. We evaluate spatial accuracy, motion errors, and estimated arithmetic energy on MPII and a fixed NTU60 Cross-Subject subset. Against the architecture-matched ANN with MAM, SpikePose cuts estimated arithmetic energy by 91.4% at a cost of just 1.12 points in head-bone-normalised PCK at 0.5 threshold (PCK_HB(0.5)). Within SpikePose, adding MAM reduces velocity and acceleration errors by 28.13% and 31.46% while slightly improving localisation, at a cost of only 0.003M parameters and 0.0023 analytical GFLOPs per frame. Code will be released on GitHub upon acceptance.
tldr: SpikePose将单步脉冲编码器与运动对齐热图记忆结合，以极低能耗实现轻量视频人体姿态估计。
motivation: 高效视频人体姿态估计需在定位精度、运动质量和能耗之间取得平衡。该工作旨在缩小脉冲神经网络与经典ANN在大规模、非事件驱动视频任务上的差距。
method: SpikePose采用帧重置的单步脉冲编码器提供逐帧空间证据，并引入运动对齐热图记忆（MAM）估计关节位移、对齐历史热图并与当前预测自适应融合。时间推理被限制在脉冲骨干之外的紧凑轻量模块中。
result: 在MPII和固定NTU60 Cross-Subject子集上评估空间精度、运动误差和估算算术能耗。与架构匹配的ANN+MAM相比，SpikePose将估算算术能耗降低91.4%，仅损失1.12个点的PCK_HB(0.5)；加入MAM使速度和加速度误差分别降低28.13%和31.46%，并略微提升定位，仅增加0.003M参数和每帧0.0023 analytical GFLOPs。
conclusion: 结果表明，在脉冲骨干外引入轻量时间模块可在保持竞争力的定位与运动质量的同时显著降低能耗，为脉冲网络用于非事件驱动视频姿态估计提供了可行路线。代码将在接收后于GitHub发布。

title: BudgetSplat: Budget-Controllable Generalizable Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting enables efficient generalizable novel view synthesis, but existing pixel-aligned methods often generate highly redundant Gaussian primitives, causing the final representation size and rendering cost to grow rapidly with image resolution and the number of input views. We propose BudgetSplat, a budget-controllable feed-forward framework that adapts the final Gaussian representation to a user-specified preservation ratio. Rather than treating compaction as simple importance ranking, we formulate it as a joint problem of importance estimation, spatial coverage, and cross-view redundancy. A single trained model supports varying numbers of context views and multiple test-time budgets without per-budget retraining or per-scene compression. To realize this formulation, Intra-Cross Mask Supervision provides structure-, coverage-, and redundancy-aware guidance for learning Gaussian importance, while budget-conditioned feature modulation adapts Gaussian opacity and attributes to the requested preservation ratio. Coverage-Aware Budget Selection further combines patch-wise pre-selection, view-wise opacity ranking, and 3D redundancy suppression to construct compact yet spatially distributed Gaussian representations. Experiments on indoor reconstruction and cross-dataset generalization demonstrate consistent quality--size trade-offs across different input view counts and preservation ratios, substantially reducing final representation storage and rendering cost while preserving rendering quality.
tldr: BudgetSplat 提出预算可控的前馈高斯泼溅框架，在保持渲染质量的同时压缩表示并降低渲染开销。
motivation: 现有前馈式像素对齐高斯泼溅方法常生成高度冗余的高斯基元，使最终表示大小和渲染成本随图像分辨率与输入视角数量快速增长。研究旨在让高斯表示适配用户指定的保留比例，实现无需逐预算重训练或逐场景压缩的可控压缩。
method: 将压缩建模为重要性估计、空间覆盖与跨视角冗余的联合问题；使用 Intra-Cross Mask Supervision 提供结构、覆盖和冗余感知的高斯重要性学习引导，并通过 budget-conditioned feature modulation 按保留比例调整高斯不透明度与属性。Coverage-Aware Budget Selection 结合分块预选、视角级不透明度排序和 3D 冗余抑制，构建紧凑且空间分布合理的高斯表示。
result: 在室内重建和跨数据集泛化实验中，方法在不同输入视角数量和保留比例下均表现出一致的质量—大小权衡，显著降低最终表示存储与渲染成本，同时保持渲染质量；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: BudgetSplat 提供了预算可控的可泛化高斯泼溅框架，单一训练模型即可支持不同上下文视角数量和多个测试时预算，无需逐预算重训练或逐场景压缩。其贡献在于将高斯压缩转化为联合优化问题并给出有效监督与选择机制，有望提升可泛化新视角合成的存储与渲染效率。

title: UniLoop: Unified Loop Closure Detection from Retrieval to Geometric Verification and Relative Pose Estimation
abstract: Loop closure detection conventionally cascades separate models for global retrieval, geometric verification, and relative pose estimation, leading to redundant computation and disconnected visual representations. We propose UniLoop, a unified framework that reuses the hierarchical representations of the pretrained geometric foundation model throughout this pipeline. A shared image encoder produces features for compact global descriptors; the same features are passed to the cross-view decoder for pairwise verification; and the original geometric predictions provide relative camera constraints for pose-graph optimization. Experiments on place recognition, loop verification, and relative pose estimation show that UniLoop improves loop-closure robustness and accuracy while reducing redundant backbone computation relative to modular pipelines. UniLoop achieves the best Recall@10 on MSLS (96.6) and Pitts30k (99.3) among the compared methods, while its verification branch reaches 95.63 AP and 96.29 ROC-AUC, surpassing the existing geometric verification baselines.
tldr: UniLoop统一闭环检测流程，复用几何基础模型表示，兼顾检索、验证与相对位姿估计。
motivation: 传统闭环检测将全局检索、几何验证和相对位姿估计级联为独立模型，导致计算冗余且视觉表示割裂；研究旨在用统一框架解决该问题。
method: UniLoop复用预训练几何基础模型的分层表示：共享图像编码器生成紧凑全局描述子，同一特征送入跨视角解码器做成对验证，原始几何预测提供相对相机约束用于位姿图优化。
result: 在位置识别、闭环验证和相对位姿估计实验中，UniLoop提升鲁棒性与精度并减少冗余骨干计算；MSLS Recall@10达96.6，Pitts30k达99.3，验证分支达95.63 AP和96.29 ROC-AUC，超过现有几何验证基线。
conclusion: UniLoop表明统一复用几何基础模型表示可有效贯通检索到几何验证及相对位姿估计，减少模块化流水线冗余，并提升闭环检测整体性能。

title: Quo Vadis, Driving Scene Reconstruction? Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification
abstract: While recent feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting methods enable efficient driving-scene reconstruction from surround-view images, their reliance on a single observation fundamentally hinders novel-view synthesis. Regions occluded in the input can become visible from novel viewpoints, leaving the reconstructed Gaussians under-constrained and incomplete. Moving beyond image-space inpainting for rendered views, we introduce OccSplat, a feed-forward framework whose core contribution is Occlusion-Aware Gaussian Densification, explicitly targeting missing scene geometry rather than missing pixels. By predicting new Gaussian primitives for unsupported regions, OccSplat completes the scene directly in the 3D representation. Specifically, OccSplat first identifies occluded regions that lack Gaussian support through Gaussian Occlusion Mapping. Gaussian Occlusion Completion then generates new primitives for these regions. The predicted primitives are integrated into the original representation to improve novel-view synthesis while retaining feed-forward inference without per-scene optimization. Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that OccSplat improves on the compared methods and yields particularly large gains in occluded regions, leading to more accurate and visually coherent driving-scene reconstruction.
tldr: OccSplat通过遮挡感知高斯稠密化补全缺失三维几何，提升驾驶场景新视角合成质量。
motivation: 现有前馈3D高斯泼溅方法仅依赖单次环绕视图观测，输入中被遮挡区域在新视角下可见时，重建高斯欠约束且不完整。论文旨在直接补全缺失的场景几何，而非仅对渲染图像做图像空间修复。
method: 提出前馈框架OccSplat，核心为遮挡感知高斯稠密化。该方法先用Gaussian Occlusion Mapping识别缺乏高斯支持的遮挡区域，再由Gaussian Occlusion Completion为这些区域生成新高斯基元，并将其融入原始表示，保持无需逐场景优化的前馈推理。
result: 在nuScenes基准上，OccSplat优于对比方法，尤其在遮挡区域取得显著提升，使驾驶场景重建更准确且视觉更连贯；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 论文将遮挡补全从图像空间推进到3D高斯表示空间，通过显式生成缺失几何提升新视角合成质量。该框架保持前馈效率，对驾驶场景重建及遮挡鲁棒性研究具有潜在影响。

title: CrossPressor: Scalable Cross-View Fusion for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) becomes increasingly difficult to scale to long multi-view sequences. Anchor-based compression methods such as ZPressor alleviate representation growth by decoding Gaussians only from a compact set of anchor feature maps, but keeping these anchors fixed forces each one to aggregate an increasing number of support views. We identify this representation--fusion mismatch and introduce \textbf{CrossPressor}, a training-free method for scalable anchor-based fusion. CrossPressor preserves all decoder-facing anchor queries while constraining the view-growing support sequence through coverage-cycled evidence routing, distributing retained spatial evidence across support views and fusion layers while keeping all support views represented. Routing before K/V projection, together with joint context packing, further reduces support-side fusion cost without retraining. CrossPressor maintains reconstruction quality close to dense fusion while achieving up to $26.12\times$ faster cross-view fusion and $1.43\times$ end-to-end acceleration on long input sequences. Our project page is at: https://yuhsihu.github.io/CrossPressor.
tldr: 提出免训练的CrossPressor，通过覆盖循环证据路由解决固定锚点导致的支持视图聚合失配，实现可扩展跨视图融合。
motivation: 前馈3D高斯泼溅在长多视图序列上难以扩展；ZPressor等锚点压缩虽抑制表示增长，但固定锚点使每个锚点需聚合越来越多的支持视图，造成表示与融合失配。
method: CrossPressor保留所有面向解码器的锚点查询，对随视图增长的支持序列采用覆盖循环证据路由，将保留的空间证据分布到不同支持视图与融合层，并保持所有支持视图被表示；同时在K/V投影前路由并联合上下文打包，以降低支持侧融合开销且无需重训练。
result: 在长输入序列上重建质量接近密集融合，跨视图融合最高加速26.12倍，端到端加速1.43倍。
conclusion: 提出一种免训练、可扩展的锚点式跨视图融合方案，缓解固定锚点与增长支持视图间的失配，为长序列前馈3D-GS提供高效融合路径。

title: METRIC-GS: Selective Metric-Scale Estimation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: A 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstruction inherits arbitrary units from structure-from-motion, so it cannot be measured or used to place AR content until someone supplies a scale. Both standard recipes are fragile on real captures: on five indoor scenes with tape-measured ceilings, a quantile floor-to-ceiling heuristic errs by 27% and metric-depth alignment by 35-71% across three networks. We present METRIC-GS, a selective scale estimator for real indoor photographs: it reads the scale off the reconstruction's own semantic content and, just as importantly, refuses when the evidence is thin. A frozen 2D teacher labels Gaussians by visibility-aware voting; instance-level size priors for architectural and furniture classes (doors, tables, the floor-to-ceiling gap) are fused by a robust maximum-likelihood step; and an inlier-mass test turns thin evidence into an explicit abstention that doubles as a router to a heavyweight metric model. On 47 ScanNet++ scenes with laser ground truth, with a configuration frozen before public evaluation, the estimator alone cuts the heuristic's mean error from 21.1% to 16.6% (9.3% on the 28 scenes it acts on) at ~11 s per scene. MASt3R remains the more accurate standalone estimator (9.9%), but routing only our refusals to it matches running it everywhere with 60% fewer invocations; this selective hybrid is the configuration we advocate. Visibility-aware voting raises the scenes the estimator can act on from 16 to 28 at unchanged deployed accuracy. Applied unchanged to 13 phone and drone captures of our own, on which MASt3R fails its own registration gate 12 times, the system improves all five captures it acts on and degrades none. We also report that a current feed-forward metric model scores 2.3% on a benchmark inside its training mixture and 28-35% on captures it has never seen: a published metric-scale number is a best case, not a deployment estimate.
tldr: 提出 METRIC-GS，利用语义先验选择性估计 3DGS 的度量尺度，并在证据不足时弃权并路由到重型模型。
motivation: 3DGS 重建从 SfM 继承任意单位，若不提供尺度就无法测量或放置 AR 内容；而现有分位数地板到天花板启发式在五个有卷尺测量天花板的室内场景上误差 27%，度量深度对齐在三个网络上误差 35-71%。因此需要一种在真实拍摄中更稳健、且能识别证据不足的度量尺度估计方法。
method: 方法从重建自身的语义内容读取尺度：用冻结的 2D 教师模型通过可见性感知投票为 Gaussian 标注类别，并融合门、桌、地板到天花板间隙等建筑与家具实例的尺寸先验，采用鲁棒最大似然估计尺度。随后以 inlier-mass 检验判断证据是否充分，证据薄弱时显式弃权，并将该弃权作为路由信号交给重型度量模型。
result: 在 47 个 ScanNet++ 场景上，配置在公开评测前冻结，仅估计器将启发式平均误差从 21.1% 降至 16.6%（其实际处理的 28 个场景为 9.3%），每场景约 11 秒；MASt3R 单独为 9.9%，但仅将弃权样本路由给它即可在调用次数减少 60% 的情况下达到与其全程运行相当的效果。可见性感知投票将可处理场景从 16 个增至 28 个且部署精度不变；在自有 13 个手机/无人机拍摄中，MASt3R 有 12 次未通过配准门控，而系统在其处理的 5 个场景上全部改善、无一退化。当前前馈度量模型在训练混合内基准为 2.3%，在未见采集上为 28-35%，说明公开度量尺度数字是最佳情况而非部署估计。
conclusion: METRIC-GS 通过语义实例先验、鲁棒融合与显式弃权路由，为真实室内照片提供更可靠的 3DGS 度量尺度，并倡导选择性混合配置。其贡献在于把证据不足转化为可操作的路由信号，同时警示已发表度量尺度指标可能严重高估实际部署表现。

title: Feature Puzzles: Single-Image Supervision for Multi-View 3D-Aware Segmentation
abstract: Humans can easily recognize the same objects across different viewpoints of a 3D scene, whereas teaching models such multi-view-consistent perception typically requires videos or calibrated multi-view captures, which are considerably more expensive and less diverse than large-scale monocular data.~In this paper, we introduce Feature Puzzles, a novel framework for learning multi-view-consistent segmentation using only single-image semantic segmentation supervision. Specifically, we propose a simple yet effective pipeline that constructs multi-view-consistent segmentation pseudo-labels through image cropping and geometric transformations. We further introduce a lightweight, plug-and-play network that leverages the multi-view-consistent image features learned by existing pretrained 3D foundation models and the generated pseudo-labels to perform multi-view-consistent segmentation. Importantly, our flexible framework supports various types of prompts provided from one or multiple views and can be readily extended to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Under this single-image supervision, our feed-forward model achieves the best mIoU on NVOS, remains competitive on SPIn-NeRF and ScanNet++ against baselines using per-scene optimization or in-domain multi-view training, and demonstrates zero-shot transfer to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Visual comparisons are available on our project page: https://featurepuzzles.github.io/
tldr: Feature Puzzles 仅用单图像语义监督，通过伪标签与3D基础模型特征实现多视角一致分割。
motivation: 人类能跨视角识别同一物体，但训练模型具备多视角一致感知通常依赖视频或标定多视角采集，成本高且多样性不如大规模单目数据。本文旨在仅使用单图像语义分割监督学习多视角一致分割，降低数据采集与标注需求。
method: 提出 Feature Puzzles 框架，通过图像裁剪和几何变换构造多视角一致的语义分割伪标签。引入轻量、即插即用网络，利用预训练3D基础模型学习到的多视角一致图像特征与伪标签进行分割，并支持来自一个或多个视角的提示，可扩展到开放词汇3D分割。
result: 在单图像监督下，前馈模型在 NVOS 上取得最佳 mIoU，在 SPIn-NeRF 和 ScanNet++ 上与逐场景优化或域内多视角训练基线相比保持竞争力，并展示开放词汇3D分割的零样本迁移能力。
conclusion: 该工作证明仅凭单图像语义监督即可学习多视角一致分割，减少对视频或标定多视角数据的依赖。框架灵活支持多视角提示和开放词汇扩展，为可扩展的3D感知分割提供了新思路。

title: Wide View Synthesis from Overlapping Perspective Cameras in Autonomous Driving
abstract: Multi-perspective-camera systems are widely adopted since they provide broad visual coverage for autonomous driving, motivating the synthesis of a unified wide view from spatially separated observations. In this work, we formulate wide view synthesis (WVS), which aims to synthesize a geometrically consistent wide view at a specified virtual viewpoint from multiple perspective cameras. Unlike conventional image stitching, WVS requires reasoning about 3D geometry and visibility to handle depth-dependent parallax and occlusions arising from spatially separated camera centers. While vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity view synthesis, its reliance on per-scene optimization limits its applicability to driving scenes. Furthermore, WVS introduces additional challenges, *e.g.*, peripheral stretching under perspective projection and photometric inconsistencies across cameras. To address these challenges, we propose **Wide-View Gaussian Splatting (WV-GS)**, a feed-forward Gaussian-splatting framework that synthesizes wide views without per-scene optimization. Specifically, we introduce Piecewise Perspective Rendering (PPR) to mitigate peripheral stretching through local perspective projections sharing a common camera center, and Spatial Affine Photometric Modeling (SAPM) to account for camera-dependent photometric variations during training. We further introduce **WideDrive**, a synthetic benchmark providing dense ground-truth wide views and adapt a LiDAR-projected sparse-reference protocol to real-world datasets. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of WV-GS for WVS. Dataset and code will be publicly released.
tldr: 提出WV-GS前馈高斯泼溅框架，从多视角相机合成几何一致的宽视角视图。
motivation: 多相机系统虽提供广泛视觉覆盖，但空间分离观测需要合成统一宽视图；传统图像拼接缺乏3D几何与可见性推理，难以处理深度相关视差和遮挡，而原始3DGS依赖逐场景优化，不适用于驾驶场景。
method: 将问题形式化为宽视图合成WVS，提出无需逐场景优化的前馈高斯泼溅框架WV-GS；引入分段透视渲染PPR，通过共享同一相机中心的局部透视投影缓解边缘拉伸，并采用空间仿射光度建模SAPM处理跨相机光度差异；同时构建提供稠密真值宽视图的WideDrive合成基准，并在真实数据集上适配LiDAR投影稀疏参考协议。
result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验证明了WV-GS在宽视图合成任务上的有效性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作为自动驾驶多相机系统提供了一种无需逐场景优化的前馈宽视图合成方案，并构建基准与适配真实数据协议，数据集和代码将公开，有望推动宽视图合成与多相机感知研究。

title: Trainspotting: Learning Object-Centric 3D Reconstruction from Found Photos
abstract: State-of-the-art feedforward reconstruction models perform poorly on in-the-wild object-centric photo collections. They are trained largely on single-session object captures whose images vary in viewpoint while the object and its environment remain nearly fixed. Public photo archives contain a different form of multi-view data. They hold found photos of the same object or design: photos taken independently by many people across years, environments, cameras, and sometimes physical units. In this work, we introduce Trainspotting, a dataset of 12,068 objects and 311,886 photos from Wikimedia Commons. We reconstruct each object to recover camera poses, multi-view stereo depth, and object masks. We categorize the objects into three regimes: objects fixed at one site, objects that move between sites, and designs shared by many physical units. Evaluating recent feedforward reconstruction models on Trainspotting shows that they fail most severely in the last two regimes. Fine-tuning VGGT-$Ω$ on Trainspotting significantly improves camera pose, depth, and 3D geometry on held-out objects. We observe similar improvements on the independent NAVI in-the-wild benchmark, which contains photos of each object in different environments. Performance on conventional benchmarks remains largely unchanged.
tldr: 提出 Trainspotting 数据集，利用公共档案中的野生对象照片提升对象中心三维重建。
motivation: 现有前馈式重建模型多在单次对象拍摄数据上训练，图像主要随视角变化而对象与环境几乎固定，因此在野生对象中心照片集合上表现较差；公共照片档案则包含同一对象或设计跨越多年、不同环境、相机乃至不同实体单元拍摄的 found photos。
method: 本文构建 Trainspotting 数据集，包含来自 Wikimedia Commons 的 12,068 个对象和 311,886 张照片，并为每个对象恢复相机位姿、多视图立体深度和对象掩码；随后将对象划分为固定于单一场地、在场地间移动、以及由多个实体单元共享的设计三种情形，并在该数据集上微调 VGGT-Ω。
result: 实验显示，近期前馈式重建模型在移动对象和共享设计两类情形下失败最严重；在 Trainspotting 上微调 VGGT-Ω 可显著提升留出对象的相机位姿、深度和三维几何质量，并在独立的 NAVI 野外基准上取得类似提升，而传统基准性能基本不变。
conclusion: 该工作提供了面向 found photos 的大规模对象中心三维重建数据集与基准，证明利用公共档案数据微调可增强模型跨环境、跨实例的泛化能力，对野外三维重建研究具有推动作用。

title: T$^2$-Splat: Adaptive Topology Mesh Splatting with Texture Residuals
abstract: Triangle-based splatting connects novel view synthesis with conventional graphics pipelines, but often requires excessive tessellation to preserve appearance details. We present T$^2$-Splat, which decouples topology adaptation from appearance refinement. Safe Restricted Delaunay Triangulation (Safe RDT) initializes mesh connectivity. Dynamic Topology Evolution (DTE) then adapts triangle allocation through edge collapse and vertex split operations. Residual per-face Mip-textures then refine appearance on the fixed mesh using scale-adaptive filtering. Experiments on Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and DTU demonstrate competitive results with compact meshes. T$^2$-Splat improves PSNR by 0.71dB over MeshSplatting on Mip-NeRF 360. Additional compression experiments demonstrate flexible control of mesh complexity, supporting face budgets as low as 10% of the original face count. Project page: https://t2-splat.github.io/.
tldr: T²-Splat 解耦拓扑自适应与外观细化，用紧凑网格实现高质量新视角合成。
motivation: 基于三角形的 splatting 能衔接新视角合成与图形管线，但为保留外观细节常需过度细分网格，导致面数冗余。本文旨在降低网格复杂度并保持渲染质量。
method: 先用 Safe Restricted Delaunay Triangulation (Safe RDT) 初始化网格连通性，再通过 Dynamic Topology Evolution (DTE) 的边折叠与顶点分裂自适应分配三角形；随后在固定网格上用逐面 Mip-texture 残差和尺度自适应滤波细化外观。
result: 在 Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples 和 DTU 上以紧凑网格取得有竞争力结果；Mip-NeRF 360 上 PSNR 较 MeshSplatting 提升 0.71 dB。压缩实验显示可将面预算降至原始面数的 10%。
conclusion: T²-Splat 证明拓扑自适应与外观残差细化可分离，在紧凑网格下实现高质量新视角合成并灵活控制网格复杂度，有利于与常规图形管线结合。

title: Visibility-Aware Reference Generation for Benchmarking Visual 3D Reconstruction in Vegetation-Rich Environments
abstract: Reliable evaluation of visual 3D reconstruction and depth estimation in vegetation-rich outdoor environments is limited by the scarcity of geometric ground-truth data and the cost of complete scanner surveys. We present a LiDARbased reference-generation pipeline for evaluating the zero-shot performance of feed-forward visual-geometry models alongside conventional structure-from-motion (SfM) methods. The pipeline reuses camera images, LiDAR scans, and reference poses from existing multi-sensor localization datasets to generate per-view depth maps and visible reference point clouds. To address visibility errors in accumulated LiDAR scans, we introduce the LargeDepth-Gap Visibility Score (LDGVS) for point-wise visibility filtering and automatic scale selection in Hidden Point Removal(HPR). Experiments on TartanAirV2 and TartanGround show that, compared with Poisson surface reconstruction, which is an approach suited to completed scan surveys, the combined HPR and LDGVS filtering retains approximately three times the point density at comparable absolute relative error. We also apply the pipeline to the BotanicGarden dataset to systematically compare depth estimation and 3D reconstruction methods. Feedforward methods produce dense depth predictions efficiently, but their 3D reconstructions can contain duplicated structures. Conventional SfM generally produces more coherent geometry, but its reconstructions remain sparse and more prone to failure in challenging vegetated scenes. The benchmark toolkit and datasets will be released.
tldr: 提出基于LiDAR的可见性感知参考生成流程，用于植被场景下视觉3D重建与深度估计的零样本评测。
motivation: 植被丰富的室外环境中几何真值稀缺且完整扫描调查成本高，导致视觉3D重建与深度估计缺乏可靠评测。本文旨在构建可复用的参考生成流程，以支持前馈视觉几何模型和传统SfM方法的零样本性能评估。
method: 该流程复用现有多传感器定位数据集中的相机图像、LiDAR扫描和参考位姿，生成逐视角深度图与可见参考点云。针对累积LiDAR扫描中的可见性误差，提出LargeDepth-Gap Visibility Score（LDGVS）进行逐点可见性过滤，并在Hidden Point Removal（HPR）中自动选择尺度。
result: 在TartanAirV2和TartanGround上，与适用于完整扫描调查的Poisson表面重建相比，HPR与LDGVS联合过滤在可比绝对相对误差下保留约三倍点密度。在BotanicGarden上系统比较显示，前馈方法能高效生成稠密深度预测但3D重建可能出现重复结构，传统SfM几何更连贯但重建稀疏且更易在复杂植被场景失败。
conclusion: 工作提供了面向植被环境的可见性感知基准参考生成方案，并将在发布基准工具包与数据集后促进视觉3D重建和深度估计的可复现评测。

title: GSCV++: Lightweight 3D Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression via Standard Video Codecs
abstract: This paper presents GSCV++, a lightweight pipeline for 3D {G}aussian {S}platting (GS) sequences {C}ompression with standard {V}ideo codecs. To meet the requirements of low-complexity and hardware compatibility from the industry, GSCV++ jointly improves preprocessing, 3D-to-2D mapping, and practical video compression configuration of GS compression. First, for preprocessing, energy-adaptive inter-frame spherical harmonic (SH) alternative current (AC) dimensionality reduction (EA-SHDR) is proposed to produces a compact and stable temporal SH AC feature space. It can reduce the data volume of following mapping and practical compression, as well as less complexity while eliminating redundant information. Second, for 3D-to-2D mapping, prior-based Inter-MiniPLAS (P-MiniPLAS) is designed to generate smooth 2D feature maps through prior-based weighting factor inference and small scale remapping. Compared with vanilla Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting (PLAS) and Morton scan, P-MiniPLAS ensures the generated 2D maps are more suitable for the video codec while maintaining a low level of computational complexity. Third, for practical compression, content-aware generalized compression (CA-GC) is developed to use a non-uniform bit-depth split for coordinate map generation, and a coding unit size selection is introduced for efficient compression complexity control, which fully exploits the performance of video codecs without involving normative changes. Experiments demonstrate that GSCV++ reports over 20\% in intra- and 60\% in inter-prediction rate-distortion gains compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. GSCV++ also achieves faster 2D map generation, encoding, and decoding than other SOTA methods using the same type of video codecs. Ablation studies verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed modules and provide insights for subsequent research.
tldr: GSCV++ 通过预处理、3D-to-2D 映射和视频编码配置联合优化，实现轻量且兼容标准视频编解码器的 3DGS 序列压缩。
motivation: 针对工业界对低复杂度与硬件兼容性的需求，GSCV++ 旨在利用标准视频编解码器高效压缩 3D Gaussian Splatting 序列，并解决现有流程在预处理、3D-to-2D 映射和实际编码配置上的效率与适配问题。
method: 方法包括：EA-SHDR 对帧间球谐 AC 特征进行能量自适应降维，构建紧凑稳定的时序特征空间；P-MiniPLAS 通过先验加权与小尺度重映射生成更适合视频编码的平滑 2D 特征图；CA-GC 采用非均匀位深划分生成坐标图，并引入编码单元尺寸选择以控制复杂度。
result: 实验表明，相较 SOTA 方法，GSCV++ 在帧内和帧间预测分别取得超过 20% 和 60% 的率失真增益；在使用同类视频编解码器时，其 2D 图生成、编码和解码速度也更快，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性与鲁棒性。
conclusion: GSCV++ 在无需修改视频编码标准的前提下，实现了轻量、硬件友好的 3DGS 序列压缩，并在率失真性能与计算效率上优于现有方法，为后续 3DGS 压缩研究提供了可复用的模块设计与实践见解。

title: Sparse Anchors for Visual Multi-Session Registration in Changing Environments
abstract: Repeated robotic monitoring requires localization across visits to the same environment, even if the environment changes. Such changes can substantially reduce persistent visual content, and repetitive structures can lead to incorrect cross-session correspondences. In this paper, we address visual multi-session registration of a new data recording (the query session) to a previously reconstructed reference map. Under substantial visual and structural changes, cross-session localization may be possible only for parts of the trajectory. In our approach, we therefore rely on a sparse set of reliable absolute pose constraints and combine them with within-session relative-pose information to register the complete trajectory to the reference map. We first estimate absolute alignment hypotheses through visual place recognition, local feature matching, and geometric verification. We then use sequence consensus to reject hypotheses that are inconsistent with a common query-to-reference alignment and retain the remaining poses as absolute anchors. These anchors are refined through featuremetric alignment against a Gaussian feature field and combined with within-session relative-pose constraints in a robust pose-graph optimization. We evaluate our approach on 15 cross-session experiments from the challenging HILTI26 construction-site dataset, covering substantial scene changes and difficult-to-match environments. Our method achieves 94.4% recall within 1m and 100.0% within 5m, outperforming independent image localization, which peaks at 65.3% and 70.7%, respectively, as well as direct registration of independently reconstructed Structure-from-Motion geometry. Our results show that sparse, reliable absolute anchors can provide accurate and complete trajectory registration even when reliable cross-session correspondences are available only for part of the query session.
tldr: 提出稀疏可靠绝对锚点结合会话内相对位姿约束，实现变化环境下的多会话轨迹配准。
motivation: 重复机器人监测需要在同一环境多次访问间进行定位，但场景变化会显著减少持久视觉内容，重复结构还会导致跨会话错误对应。论文旨在解决视觉与结构变化显著时，将新查询会话轨迹配准到已有参考地图的多会话配准问题。
method: 先通过视觉位置识别、局部特征匹配和几何验证生成绝对对齐假设，利用序列一致性剔除不符合共同查询-参考对齐的假设，保留可靠位姿作为绝对锚点。锚点通过高斯特征场上的featuremetric对齐进行细化，并与会话内相对位姿约束结合，在鲁棒位姿图优化中完成完整轨迹配准。
result: 在HILTI26建筑工地数据集的15个跨会话实验中，方法在1m内达到94.4%召回率、5m内达到100.0%，优于独立图像定位的65.3%和70.7%，也优于独立重建SfM几何的直接配准。
conclusion: 结果表明，即使可靠跨会话对应仅覆盖查询会话的一部分，稀疏且可靠的绝对锚点仍可提供准确完整的轨迹配准，为变化环境下的多会话视觉定位提供了有效方案。

title: iMED: A Multi-Endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
abstract: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.
tldr: 提出首个同步多内窥镜手术数据集iMED，含双立体视角，并建立跨内窥镜几何泛化评测基准。
motivation: 现有手术视觉数据集多来自单内窥镜单轨迹，缺乏独立留出视角，难以区分几何泛化与沿前向窄路径的光度插值。iMED旨在解决这一评测缺陷，为机器人辅助微创手术的3D感知提供多视角基准。
method: 数据集包含340个序列、约170K同步时间点，每个时间点4视角，由两个独立立体内窥镜在离体、尸检和活体场景下同步采集，覆盖14个标本及多样解剖区域与运动模式。提供标定相机内参、基于ArUco的逐帧位姿及不确定性、器械分割掩码和临床元数据；采用单内窥镜训练、另一内窥镜测试协议，评测23种SOTA方法在刚体/非刚体新视角合成、位姿估计、特征匹配和单目深度估计上的表现。
result: 实验表明，主要依赖光度监督的方法在留出内窥镜设置下性能显著下降，而具有显式几何正则化的方法跨视角更鲁棒。大规模基础模型迁移到手术图像上表现意外地好，常优于领域专用模型，提示当前微调协议可能存在问题。
conclusion: iMED为手术视觉中的几何泛化建立了新的评测协议，揭示了光度监督方法的局限和基础模型迁移的潜力，有望推动更鲁棒的手术3D感知方法发展。

title: Phase-DGS: Phase-guided Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Unsynchronized Multi-view Video
abstract: Spatiotemporal scene reconstruction with Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (DGS) fundamentally depends on perfect temporal synchronization across all cameras, an assumption rarely achievable in practice. Industry-standard synchronization requires expensive specialized hardware and complex setup, while data-driven alternatives including audio-based alignment, geometry matching, and pose tracking remain limited by restrictive environmental or scene-specific assumptions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Phase-DGS, a framework that replaces conventional timestamps with a semantic phase representing each frame's inherent state within the underlying motion cycle. Frames capturing the same motion state share the same phase regardless of which camera records them or when, naturally establishing spatiotemporal correspondence across unsynchronized cameras. We validate Phase-DGS under temporal offsets, frame drops, and camera freezes, achieving up to +8.5 dB PSNR improvement over baselines while enabling seamless integration with existing DGS backbones including RealTime-4DGS and FreeTimeGS.
tldr: Phase-DGS利用语义相位替代时间戳，实现无同步多视角视频的动态高斯重建。
motivation: 动态高斯泼溅的时空重建依赖所有相机完美时间同步，但实际中专业硬件昂贵且音频对齐、几何匹配、位姿跟踪等数据驱动方法受环境或场景假设限制。本文旨在消除对同步时间戳和专用硬件的依赖。
method: 提出 Phase-DGS，用表示每帧在运动周期中固有状态的语义相位替代传统时间戳；同一运动状态的不同相机帧共享相位，从而在非同步相机间自然建立时空对应。该方法可无缝集成到 RealTime-4DGS、FreeTimeGS 等现有 DGS 主干。
result: 在时间偏移、丢帧和相机冻结条件下验证，PSNR 较基线最高提升 8.5 dB，并可与 RealTime-4DGS 和 FreeTimeGS 无缝集成。
conclusion: Phase-DGS 将同步问题转化为运动相位对应，提升了非同步多视角动态重建的鲁棒性与精度，并具备作为现有 DGS 框架通用插件的潜力。

title: 3DGS-VBench+ and 3DGSV-Assessor: A Multi-Dimensional Subjective Benchmark and a Reference-Flexible Objective Model for 3D Gaussian Splatting Video Quality Assessment
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis (NVS), but its heavy storage makes compression essential, and both training and compression introduce representation-specific distortions. Since generative compression in many methods treats geometric and color attributes via different parameters, it can induce dimension-specific distortions, motivating multi-dimensional assessment. Moreover, real-world captures generally lack an aligned ground-truth video for a synthesized, continuous camera trajectory, leaving only sparse captured views as references. To enable multi-dimensional quality assessment of 3DGS videos with scarce aligned references, we first present 3DGS-VBench+, a large-scale subjective video quality assessment (VQA) benchmark comprising 3{,}036 3DGS reconstructions, each paired with a rendered video, across 11 real-world and 22 synthetic scenes, generated by 6 representative compression algorithms at systematically designed levels and annotated with 9{,}108 MOSs covering overall, geometry, and color quality. Based on 3DGS-VBench+, we propose 3DGSV-Assessor, a reference-flexible, large multimodal framework that scores all three dimensions in one generation pass and fuses a ranking-based reference cue into the frozen regressor through a bounded gate, supporting both reduced-reference (RR) and no-reference (NR) assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art correlation with human perception on 3DGS-VBench+ and strong zero-shot generalization to other NVS benchmarks. The dataset and code will be released at https://github.com/YukeXing/3DGSV-Assessor.
tldr: 提出3DGS视频多维主观质量基准3DGS-VBench+及参考灵活的多模态客观评价模型3DGSV-Assessor。
motivation: 3DGS虽支持实时新视角合成，但存储开销大、必须压缩，训练与压缩会引入表示特定失真；生成式压缩对几何与颜色属性采用不同参数，导致维度特定失真，因此需要多维度评估。同时，真实采集场景通常缺少与合成连续相机轨迹对齐的真值视频，仅有稀疏采集视图可作参考。
method: 构建大规模主观VQA基准3DGS-VBench+，包含3,036个3DGS重建及对应渲染视频，覆盖11个真实与22个合成场景、6种代表性压缩算法及系统化设置，标注9,108个MOS（整体、几何、颜色质量）。提出3DGSV-Assessor多模态框架，一次生成同时输出三个维度分数，并通过有界门控将基于排序的参考线索融合进冻结回归器，支持缩减参考（RR）与无参考（NR）评估。
result: 在3DGS-VBench+上与人类感知的相关性达到当前最优，并对其他NVS基准表现出较强的零样本泛化能力。
conclusion: 该工作为缺乏对齐参考的3DGS视频多维质量评估提供了大规模主观基准与参考灵活的客观模型，有助于推动3DGS压缩与NVS质量评价研究。数据集与代码将开源。

title: Auditing Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Correction before Recursive Use
abstract:
Camera-LiDAR fusion repeatedly uses an extrinsic transform in projection, association, and recursive state estimation. We study whether a targetless correction should be admitted to a downstream consumer only after separate audits of correction quality, confidence ranking, and recursive risk. Our log-disjoint protocol evaluates these stages under synthetic extrinsic drift on Argoverse 2 and treats cross-dataset and odometry experiments as bounded diagnostics.
  On 27 test-split logs, single-frame Canny alignment is harmful in the mild tier. Multi-frame alignment improves severe-tier rotation by 2.52 degrees but worsens translation by 0.177 m; its declared joint error-magnitude improvement is also negative (-0.158, 95% CI [-0.223, -0.098]), so the rotation gain is not a six-degree-of-freedom correction success. A zero-injection check moves away from the true extrinsic, and solver-disagreement AUROC on selected splits does not yield a validated nonzero-coverage risk-coverage operating point.
  In a 15-log final system role, the locked conservative policy admits no candidate and equals Raw, whereas Always-correct increases trajectory error. These results support an auditable separation of correction, confidence, and recursive contamination; they do not establish a deployable calibration gate, positive odometry or SLAM improvement, map consistency, or closed-loop safety.
tldr: 提出日志分离审计框架，分别检验无目标相机-LiDAR外参校正的质量、置信度与递归风险；旋转虽改善但平移恶化，保守门控不接纳候选。
motivation: 相机-LiDAR融合在投影、关联和递归状态估计中反复使用外参，因此需要判断无目标外参校正是否应仅在通过校正质量、置信度排序和递归风险三项独立审计后才被下游接纳，以避免有害校正进入闭环。
method: 在Argoverse 2上构造合成外参漂移，采用日志不重叠协议分阶段评估单帧/多帧对齐、零注入检查和求解器分歧AUROC，并将跨数据集与里程计实验作为有界诊断。
result: 在27条测试日志上，单帧Canny对齐在轻度漂移层有害；多帧对齐将严重层旋转改善2.52度，却使平移恶化0.177 m，声明的联合误差幅度改善为负（-0.158，95% CI [-0.223, -0.098]）。零注入检查偏离真值，求解器分歧AUROC未给出经验证的非零覆盖率风险-覆盖率工作点；在15条日志的最终系统角色中，锁定保守策略不接纳任何候选且等同Raw，而Always-correct增大轨迹误差。
conclusion: 结果支持将校正、置信度与递归污染进行可审计分离，但未建立可部署的标定门控、正向里程计/SLAM提升、地图一致性或闭环安全性。

title: IGSW: Multi-Weather Urban Scene Reconstruction with Intrinsic-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting
abstract: High-fidelity weather editing of 4D scenes can support end-to-end training and closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving. Combining generative image editing with dynamic Gaussian representations enables multi-weather scene reconstruction, but weather-edited images often contain structural distortions. Directly fitting their appearance may propagate errors from teacher images into the reconstructed 4D scene, compromising the original scene structure and temporal continuity. To address these challenges, we propose IGSW, a two-stage framework that combines intrinsic-decoupled 4D Gaussian scene modeling with structure-preserving weather refinement. In Stage I, background Gaussian appearance is decomposed into weather-shared albedo and normals and weather-specific irradiance and residuals. Weather teacher images generated by a diffusion-based image editing model and intrinsic maps estimated by a diffusion-based inverse renderer provide feature-level soft supervision for stable structure and illumination changes. In Stage II, a structure-preservation gate combines semantic conflicts with cross-weather intrinsic discrepancies to suppress unreliable teacher regions. Per-Gaussian weather transport variables and target-weather branches then strengthen the desired weather appearance over the intrinsic-decoupled scene. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo show that IGSW achieves the highest content similarity and semantic consistency and the lowest temporal error among the compared methods, while retaining pronounced weather-dependent illumination and atmosphere. The project page is available at https://akaxi6.github.io/IGSW/ .
tldr: IGSW通过本征解耦高斯泼溅与结构保持天气细化，实现多天气城市4D场景重建。
motivation: 高保真4D场景天气编辑可支撑自动驾驶端到端训练与闭环仿真，但生成式天气编辑图像常含结构畸变，直接拟合会将教师图像误差传播到4D场景，破坏原始结构与时间连续性。
method: 提出两阶段框架：Stage I将背景高斯外观解耦为天气共享的反照率与法线及天气特定的辐照度与残差，并以扩散编辑教师图像和扩散逆渲染本征图进行特征级软监督；Stage II利用语义冲突与跨天气本征差异构建结构保持门控抑制不可靠教师区域，再通过逐高斯天气传输变量和目标天气分支增强目标天气外观。
result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上，IGSW在对比方法中取得最高的内容相似度与语义一致性以及最低的时间误差，同时保留显著的天气相关光照与大气效果；摘要未提供具体量化数值。
conclusion: IGSW通过本征解耦4D高斯建模与结构保持天气细化，在实现多天气外观编辑的同时维持场景结构与时间连续性，为自动驾驶多天气闭环仿真提供了有效方案。

title: EndoS3:Endoscopic Semantic Splatting SLAM
abstract: Purpose: Despite advances in 3D surgical scene understanding, semantic simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM) remains under-explored for two key reasons. First, it requires solving three challenging tasks in parallel: camera pose tracking, high-fidelity deformable reconstruction, and semantic mapping, making progress particularly demanding. Second, the scarcity of datasets providing the necessary ground truth to evaluate all three tasks comprehensively under conditions that closely reflect real surgical procedures environments. Method: We propose EndoS3, a Gaussian Splatting-based semantic SLAM framework that uses instance masks to guide all three tasks. An instance-level motion decomposition module separates static and dynamic instances by evaluating residual flow after compensating for camera motion, accounting for flow noise and comparing motion across neighbouring instances. The camera is tracked against the static Gaussians, while an instance-aware warp field gives each dynamic instance its own control nodes and deformation network. A semantic node allocation module redistributes a fixed node budget across instances according to their size and non-rigidity. We also introduce CRCD++, an ex-vivo Cholecystectomy dataset with RGB-D frames, camera pose and instance annotations for full semantic SLAM evaluation. Results: EndoS3 surpasses all state-of-the-art general-purpose and surgical semantic SLAM methods in tracking, reconstruction and semantic mapping on the CRCD++ and SemSup datasets. Conclusion: Semantic-aware motion and deformation modelling is vital to surgical semantic SLAM. EndoS3 and CRCD++ offer a method and benchmark for improved geometric and semantic understanding in endoscopy.
tldr: 提出基于高斯泼溅的语义SLAM框架EndoS3及CRCD++数据集，统一提升内窥镜追踪、重建与语义建图。
motivation: 内窥镜语义SLAM需并行解决相机位姿跟踪、高保真可变形重建和语义建图，且缺少能全面评估三项任务的真实手术场景数据集，导致进展受限。
method: EndoS3以实例掩码贯穿三项任务：实例级运动分解在补偿相机运动后依据残差光流并考虑噪声和邻域实例区分动静；相机对静态高斯跟踪，动态实例由带独立控制节点和变形网络的实例感知warp field建模；语义节点分配按实例尺寸与非刚性重分配固定节点预算。同时构建CRCD++离体胆囊切除RGB-D数据集，含位姿和实例标注。
result: 在CRCD++和SemSup数据集上，EndoS3在相机跟踪、重建和语义建图方面均超过现有通用及手术语义SLAM方法；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 表明语义感知的运动与变形建模对外科语义SLAM至关重要；EndoS3与CRCD++为内窥镜场景的几何与语义理解提供方法和基准。

title: Mamba3R: Fixed-Capacity Selective State Memory for Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction must maintain geometric quality over long inputs within a fixed GPU budget. A pretrained recurrent model provides bounded state, but freezing its backbone also fixes its learned state-observation interactions. We introduce Mamba3R, a jointly designed state-memory adapter that provides a trainable adaptation path without updating the backbone or task heads. A selective state-space mixer jointly transforms native state features and a fixed-capacity auxiliary memory, explicit read and write paths carry information across frames, and a decomposed feedback path regulates what the added memory feeds back. Only 1.28 million adapter parameters are trained. Under a shared periodic-reset protocol, it lowers trajectory error and improves accumulated surface and depth accuracy over recurrent baselines on public indoor and outdoor datasets and robot-recorded traversals, gaining up to 40 percent on one metric. Matched comparisons support both the choice of the mixing operator and the utility of carrying the auxiliary memory across frames. Allocated memory remains unchanged and throughput moves by at most 1.4 percent from one to two thousand frames. Replaying its recorded traversals offline, the platform's RTX 4060 averages 11.7 frames per second within 5.1 GiB with the same checkpoint, a mean throughput covering the 10 Hz sensor rate.
tldr: Mamba3R 用固定容量选择性状态记忆适配器提升长序列流式三维重建，且不更新主干。
motivation: 流式三维重建需要在固定 GPU 预算下对长输入保持几何质量。预训练循环模型虽提供有界状态，但冻结主干会固定其已学到的状态-观测交互，限制适配能力。
method: 提出 Mamba3R 状态记忆适配器，在不更新主干和任务头的前提下提供可训练适配路径。选择性状态空间混合器联合变换原生状态特征与固定容量辅助记忆，显式读写路径跨帧传递信息，分解反馈路径调节辅助记忆的回馈；仅训练 128 万适配器参数。
result: 在共享周期重置协议下，于公开室内外数据集和机器人记录轨迹上降低轨迹误差并提升累积表面与深度精度，相对循环基线在某一指标上最高提升 40%。匹配实验支持混合算子选择与跨帧辅助记忆的有效性；内存分配不变，帧数从 1000 增至 2000 时吞吐变化不超过 1.4%。RTX 4060 上以同一检查点在 5.1 GiB 内平均 11.7 FPS，覆盖 10 Hz 传感器速率。
conclusion: Mamba3R 以极小适配参数和固定容量记忆实现长序列流式三维重建的稳定高效适配，在不更新主干的情况下提升几何与轨迹精度，并保持内存与吞吐稳定，具备部署于资源受限平台的潜力。

title: GaussianRenderFormer: Transformer-based Rendering of 3D Gaussian Splats
abstract: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? We present GaussianRenderFormer, a transformer that takes a set of Gaussians and a camera and outputs the image directly. Each Gaussian becomes one token in a view-independent encoder, and a view-dependent decoder turns small patches of camera rays into pixels by attending to those tokens. Trained on 26,820 Objaverse objects pruned to 20,000 Gaussians each, GaussianRenderFormer renders 300 unseen objects at 38.08 dB PSNR against the full, unpruned splats, while rasterizing the same pruned input reaches 44.02 dB.
